title: Use page controls to represent movement between an ordered list of pages

statement.en: Choose or apply page controls to represent movement between an ordered list of pages in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではpage controls to represent movement between an ordered list of pagesを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

title: Avoid animated page transitions while scrubbing

statement.en: Avoid animating each page transition while a person scrubs through an iOS or iPadOS page control.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのpage controlをscrubしている間は、各ページ遷移をアニメーションしない。

conditions: Use the animated scrolling transition for taps, not rapid scrubbing.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Page controls experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
